title: Crosstalk-Solutions/project-nomad
title_zh: 知识 That Never Goes Offline

paragraphs.en: Project NOMAD is an offline-first knowledge and education server. Wikipedia, thousands of books, courses, maps, and optional local AI, all running on hardware you own with no internet required.
paragraphs.zh: NOMAD 项目是一个离线优先的知识与教育服务器。 维基百科、数千本书籍、课程、地图，以及可选的本地 AI，全部运行在你拥有的硬件上，无需互联网。

sents.en: Project NOMAD is an offline-first knowledge and education server.
sents.zh: NOMAD 项目是一个离线优先的知识与教育服务器。

sents.en: Wikipedia, thousands of books, courses, maps, and optional local AI, all running on hardware you own with no internet required.
sents.zh: 维基百科、数千本书籍、课程、地图，以及可选的本地 AI，全部运行在你拥有的硬件上，无需互联网。

paragraphs.en: Project NOMAD is a self-contained, offline-first knowledge and education server packed with critical tools, knowledge, and AI to keep you informed and empowered — anytime, anywhere.
paragraphs.zh: NOMAD 项目是一个自包含、离线优先的知识与教育服务器，内置了关键工具、知识和 AI，让您随时随地都能保持信息灵通、能力满满。

paragraphs.en: Project NOMAD can be installed on any Debian-based operating system (we recommend Ubuntu 26.04 LTS; 24.04 LTS and Debian 12 are also supported). Installation is completely terminal-based, and all tools and resources are designed to be accessed through the browser, so there's no need for a desktop environment if you'd rather setup NOMAD as a "server" and access it through other clients.
paragraphs.zh: Project NOMAD 可以安装在任何基于 Debian 的操作系统上（我们推荐 Ubuntu 26.04 LTS；也支持 24.04 LTS 和 Debian 12）。 安装完全基于终端，所有工具和资源都设计为通过浏览器访问，因此如果您更愿意把 NOMAD 设置成“服务器”并通过其他客户端访问，就不需要桌面环境。

sents.en: Project NOMAD can be installed on any Debian-based operating system (we recommend Ubuntu 26.04 LTS; 24.04 LTS and Debian 12 are also supported).
sents.zh: Project NOMAD 可以安装在任何基于 Debian 的操作系统上（我们推荐 Ubuntu 26.04 LTS；也支持 24.04 LTS 和 Debian 12）。

sents.en: Installation is completely terminal-based, and all tools and resources are designed to be accessed through the browser, so there's no need for a desktop environment if you'd rather setup NOMAD as a "server" and access it through other clients.
sents.zh: 安装完全基于终端，所有工具和资源都设计为通过浏览器访问，因此如果您更愿意把 NOMAD 设置成“服务器”并通过其他客户端访问，就不需要桌面环境。

paragraphs.en: Before you start: NOMAD itself needs about 5 GB of disk and under 1 GB of RAM . The offline content you add afterwards is what actually fills a drive, and the AI Assistant is what drives the memory requirement up. See Device Requirements for both, and the FAQ for individual content sizes.
paragraphs.zh: 开始之前：NOMAD 本身大约需要 5 GB 磁盘空间和不到 1 GB 的内存。 之后你添加的离线内容才是真正占满磁盘的东西，而 AI 助手则是推高内存需求的原因。 两者请参见设备要求，各内容的具体大小请参见常见问题。

paragraphs.en: Note: sudo/root privileges are required to run the install script
paragraphs.zh: 注意：运行安装脚本需要 sudo/root 权限

paragraphs.en: sudo apt-get update && \ sudo apt-get install -y curl && \ curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crosstalk-Solutions/project-nomad/refs/heads/main/install/install_nomad.sh \ -o install_nomad.sh && \ sudo bash install_nomad.sh Project NOMAD is now installed on your device! Open a browser and navigate to http://localhost:8080 (or http://DEVICE_IP:8080 ) to start exploring!

paragraphs.en: For more control over the installation process, copy and paste the Docker Compose template into a docker-compose.yml file and customize it to your liking (be sure to replace any placeholders with your actual values). Then, run docker compose up -d to start the Command Center and its dependencies. Note: this method is recommended for advanced users only, as it requires familiarity with Docker and manual configuration before starting.
paragraphs.zh: 若需对安装过程进行更多控制，可将 Docker Compose 模板复制粘贴到 docker-compose.yml 文件中，并按自己的喜好进行自定义（请务必将所有占位符替换为你的实际值）。 然后，运行 docker compose up -d 以启动 Command Center 及其依赖项。 注意：此方法仅建议高级用户使用，因为它需要熟悉 Docker，并在启动前进行手动配置。

paragraphs.en: NOMAD is a management UI ("Command Center") and API that orchestrates a collection of containerized tools and resources via Docker . It handles installation, configuration, and updates for everything — so you don't have to.
paragraphs.zh: NOMAD 是一个管理界面（“指挥中心”）和 API，通过 Docker 编排一组容器化的工具和资源。 它负责处理所有内容的安装、配置和更新——这样你就无需亲自动手。

sents.en: NOMAD is a management UI ("Command Center") and API that orchestrates a collection of containerized tools and resources via Docker .
sents.zh: NOMAD 是一个管理界面（“指挥中心”）和 API，通过 Docker 编排一组容器化的工具和资源。

sents.en: It handles installation, configuration, and updates for everything — so you don't have to.
sents.zh: 它负责处理所有内容的安装、配置和更新——这样你就无需亲自动手。

paragraphs.en: NOMAD also includes built-in tools like a Wikipedia content selector, ZIM library manager, and content explorer.
paragraphs.zh: NOMAD 还内置了多种工具，例如维基百科内容选择器、ZIM 库管理器和内容浏览器。

paragraphs.en: While many similar offline survival computers are designed to be run on bare-minimum, lightweight hardware, Project NOMAD is quite the opposite. To install and run the available AI tools, we highly encourage the use of a beefy, GPU-backed device to make the most of your install.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然许多类似的离线生存计算机都是为在最低配置的轻量级硬件上运行而设计的，但 Project NOMAD 却恰恰相反。 要安装和运行现有的 AI 工具，我们强烈建议使用配备 GPU 的强大设备，以充分发挥安装的效用。

paragraphs.en: Adding the AI Assistant brings the install to roughly 25 GB , because Ollama and a general-purpose model are both large, and a model needs about its download size in memory while it answers. That memory comes from VRAM if you have a discrete GPU and from system RAM if you do not, which is the single biggest reason the figures below are so much higher.
paragraphs.zh: 添加 AI 助手后，安装体积大约达到 25 GB，因为 Ollama 和一个通用模型都很大，而且模型在回答时所需的内存约等于其下载大小。 如果你有独立显卡，这部分内存来自显存；如果没有，则来自系统内存，这也是下表数字大幅增加的最主要原因。

paragraphs.en: Again, Project NOMAD itself is quite lightweight — it's the tools and resources you choose to install with NOMAD that will determine the specs required for your unique deployment
paragraphs.zh: 同样，Project NOMAD 本身非常轻量——真正决定你独特部署所需配置规格的，是你选择随 NOMAD 一起安装的工具和资源。

paragraphs.en: By default, NOMAD's installer will attempt to setup Ollama on the host when the AI Assistant is installed. However, if you would like to run the AI model on a different host, you can go to the settings of the AI assistant and input a URL for either an ollama or OpenAI-compatible API server (such as LM Studio). Note that if you use Ollama on a different host, you must start the server with this option: OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0 . Ollama is the preferred way to use the AI assistant, as it has features such as model download that OpenAI API does not support. So when using LM Studio, for example, you will have to use LM Studio to download models. You are responsible for the setup of Ollama/OpenAI server on the other host.
paragraphs.zh: 默认情况下，安装 AI 助手时，NOMAD 的安装程序会尝试在主机上设置 Ollama。 但是，如果您想在不同的主机上运行 AI 模型，可以进入 AI 助手的设置，输入一个 ollama 或 OpenAI 兼容的 API 服务器（例如 LM Studio）的 URL。 请注意，如果您在其他主机上使用 Ollama，必须使用以下选项启动服务器：OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0。 Ollama 是使用 AI 助手的首选方式，因为它具有 OpenAI API 不支持的诸如模型下载等功能。 因此，例如在使用 LM Studio 时，您将不得不使用 LM Studio 来下载模型。 您需要自行负责在其他主机上设置 Ollama/OpenAI 服务器。

paragraphs.en: For answers to common questions about Project NOMAD, please see our FAQ page.
paragraphs.zh: 有关 Project NOMAD 的常见问题解答，请参阅我们的 FAQ 页面。

paragraphs.en: Project NOMAD is designed for offline usage. An internet connection is only required during the initial installation (to download dependencies) and if you (the user) decide to download additional tools and resources at a later time. Otherwise, NOMAD does not require an internet connection and has ZERO built-in telemetry.
paragraphs.zh: NOMAD 项目专为离线使用而设计。 只有在初始安装期间（用于下载依赖项），以及当你（用户）决定在之后下载其他工具和资源时，才需要互联网连接。 除此之外，NOMAD 不需要互联网连接，且完全没有任何内置遥测功能。

paragraphs.en: To test internet connectivity, NOMAD first attempts to make a request to Cloudflare's utility endpoint, https://1.1.1.1/cdn-cgi/trace . If that endpoint is unreachable (for example, because your network blocks 1.1.1.1 ), it falls back to other endpoints the application already contacts (the GitHub API and the Project NOMAD API) and considers the connection online if any of them respond.
paragraphs.zh: 为了测试网络连通性，NOMAD 首先会尝试向 Cloudflare 的工具端点 https://1.1.1.1/cdn-cgi/trace 发起请求。 如果该端点不可达（例如因为你的网络屏蔽了 1.1.1.1），它会回退到应用程序本来就会访问的其他端点（GitHub API 和 Project NOMAD API），只要其中任何一个有响应，就认为连接处于在线状态。

sents.en: To test internet connectivity, NOMAD first attempts to make a request to Cloudflare's utility endpoint, https://1.1.1.1/cdn-cgi/trace .
sents.zh: 为了测试网络连通性，NOMAD 首先会尝试向 Cloudflare 的工具端点 https://1.1.1.1/cdn-cgi/trace 发起请求。

sents.en: If that endpoint is unreachable (for example, because your network blocks 1.1.1.1 ), it falls back to other endpoints the application already contacts (the GitHub API and the Project NOMAD API) and considers the connection online if any of them respond.
sents.zh: 如果该端点不可达（例如因为你的网络屏蔽了 1.1.1.1），它会回退到应用程序本来就会访问的其他端点（GitHub API 和 Project NOMAD API），只要其中任何一个有响应，就认为连接处于在线状态。

paragraphs.en: You can override the endpoint used for this check in two ways. The connectivity test URL can be configured from the UI under Settings → Advanced (stored locally on your instance), or you can set the INTERNET_STATUS_TEST_URL environment variable. When set, the environment variable always takes precedence over the UI-configured value. If neither is set, the built-in defaults above are used.
paragraphs.zh: 你可以通过两种方式覆盖此检查所使用的端点。 连接性测试 URL 可以在 UI 中的「设置 → 高级」下进行配置（存储在你的实例本地），或者你可以设置 INTERNET_STATUS_TEST_URL 环境变量。 设置后，环境变量始终优先于 UI 中配置的值。 如果两者都未设置，则使用上述内置默认值。

paragraphs.en: By design, Project NOMAD is intended to be open and available without hurdles — it includes no authentication. If you decide to connect your device to a local network after install (e.g. for allowing other devices to access its resources), you can block/open ports to control which services are exposed.
paragraphs.zh: Project NOMAD（NOMAD 项目）在设计上就是开放且无门槛可用的——它不包含任何身份验证功能。 如果你在安装后决定将设备连接到本地网络（例如为了让其他设备能够访问其资源），你可以通过封堵/开放端口来控制暴露哪些服务。

sents.en: By design, Project NOMAD is intended to be open and available without hurdles — it includes no authentication.
sents.zh: Project NOMAD（NOMAD 项目）在设计上就是开放且无门槛可用的——它不包含任何身份验证功能。

sents.en: If you decide to connect your device to a local network after install (e.g. for allowing other devices to access its resources), you can block/open ports to control which services are exposed.
sents.zh: 如果你在安装后决定将设备连接到本地网络（例如为了让其他设备能够访问其资源），你可以通过封堵/开放端口来控制暴露哪些服务。

paragraphs.en: Will authentication be added in the future? Maybe. It's not currently a priority, but if there's enough demand for it, we may consider building in an optional authentication layer in a future release to support use cases where multiple users need access to the same instance but with different permission levels (e.g. family use with parental controls, classroom use with teacher/admin accounts, etc.). We have a suggestion for this on our public roadmap, so if this is something you'd like to see, please upvote it here: https://roadmap.projectnomad.us/posts/1/user-authentication-please-build-in-user-auth-with-admin-user-roles
paragraphs.zh: 未来会加入身份验证吗？也许会。 这目前不是优先事项，但如果需求足够多，我们可能会考虑在未来版本中加入一个可选的身份验证层，以支持多用户访问同一实例但权限级别不同的使用场景（例如带家长控制的家庭使用、带教师/管理员账户的课堂使用等）。 我们的公开路线图上有一条与此相关的建议，所以如果你希望看到这个功能，请在这里投票支持：https://roadmap.projectnomad.us/posts/1/user-authentication-please-build-in-user-auth-with-admin-user-roles

sents.en: Will authentication be added in the future? Maybe.
sents.zh: 未来会加入身份验证吗？也许会。

sents.en: It's not currently a priority, but if there's enough demand for it, we may consider building in an optional authentication layer in a future release to support use cases where multiple users need access to the same instance but with different permission levels (e.g. family use with parental controls, classroom use with teacher/admin accounts, etc.).
sents.zh: 这目前不是优先事项，但如果需求足够多，我们可能会考虑在未来版本中加入一个可选的身份验证层，以支持多用户访问同一实例但权限级别不同的使用场景（例如带家长控制的家庭使用、带教师/管理员账户的课堂使用等）。

sents.en: We have a suggestion for this on our public roadmap, so if this is something you'd like to see, please upvote it here: https://roadmap.projectnomad.us/posts/1/user-authentication-please-build-in-user-auth-with-admin-user-roles

paragraphs.en: For now, we recommend using network-level controls to manage access if you're planning to expose your NOMAD instance to other devices on a local network. NOMAD is not designed to be exposed directly to the internet, and we strongly advise against doing so unless you really know what you're doing, have taken appropriate security measures, and understand the risks involved.
paragraphs.zh: 目前，如果您计划将您的 NOMAD 实例暴露给局域网中的其他设备，我们建议使用网络级控制来管理访问。 NOMAD 并非设计为直接暴露在互联网上，我们强烈建议不要这样做，除非您确实清楚自己在做什么、已采取适当的安全措施，并了解其中涉及的风险。

paragraphs.en: The Command Center can automatically install minor/patch updates of itself during a configurable window, after a cool-off period, and only when pre-flight checks pass (sufficient disk for the new image, no downloads or app installs in progress). Major versions always require a manual update.
paragraphs.zh: 命令中心可以在可配置的时间窗口内、经过冷却期之后，且仅在预检通过（有足够磁盘空间容纳新镜像、没有正在进行的下载或应用安装）时，自动安装自身的次要/补丁更新。 主要版本始终需要手动更新。

sents.en: The Command Center can automatically install minor/patch updates of itself during a configurable window, after a cool-off period, and only when pre-flight checks pass (sufficient disk for the new image, no downloads or app installs in progress).
sents.zh: 命令中心可以在可配置的时间窗口内、经过冷却期之后，且仅在预检通过（有足够磁盘空间容纳新镜像、没有正在进行的下载或应用安装）时，自动安装自身的次要/补丁更新。

sents.en: Major versions always require a manual update.
sents.zh: 主要版本始终需要手动更新。

paragraphs.zh: 由于使用真实的版本升级来执行此逻辑并不切实际，Ace 命令可以在不触发任何更新的情况下运行整个决策流程。 在 admin/ 目录下运行它：

sents.en: Because exercising this logic with real version bumps is impractical, an Ace command runs the entire decision pipeline without ever triggering an update .
sents.zh: 由于使用真实的版本升级来执行此逻辑并不切实际，Ace 命令可以在不触发任何更新的情况下运行整个决策流程。

sents.en: Run it from the admin/ directory:
sents.zh: 在 admin/ 目录下运行它：

paragraphs.en: # 1) Deterministic scenario suite — no network, DB, or Docker required. # Proves every branch (major-only, cool-off, prerelease/draft, window wrap, …) # and exits non-zero on failure, so it's safe to wire into CI. node ace auto-update:dry-run --scenarios # 2) Simulate "what would happen if I were running 1.32.0 right now?" # against the LIVE GitHub releases feed and real pre-flight checks: node ace auto-update:dry-run --current=1.32.0 --force-enabled # 3) Fully offline simulation with a canned release list and a fixed clock: node ace auto-update:dry-run --current=1.32.0 --force-enabled \ --releases-file=./fixtures/releases.json --now=2026-06-04T21:00:00Z \ --window-start=20:00 --window-end=23:00 --cooloff=72 --skip-preflight It prints the resolved decision — current version, whether the clock is inside the window, the eligible target (if any), and pre-flight blockers — ending in a clear verdict such as WOULD UPDATE → v1.33.2 or WOULD NOT UPDATE (outside-window): … . No real update is ever requested.
paragraphs.zh: # 1) 确定性场景套件 — 无需网络、数据库或 Docker。 # 验证每个分支（仅主要版本、冷却期、预发布/草稿、窗口跨越等） # 失败时以非零状态码退出，因此可以安全地接入 CI。 node ace auto-update:dry-run --scenarios # 2) 针对 LIVE GitHub 发布源和真实的预检查，模拟“如果我现在运行的是 1.32.0 会发生什么？”： node ace auto-update:dry-run --current=1.32.0 --force-enabled # 3) 使用预置的发布列表和固定时钟进行完全离线模拟： node ace auto-update:dry-run --current=1.32.0 --force-enabled \ --releases-file=./fixtures/releases.json --now=2026-06-04T21:00:00Z \ --window-start=20:00 --window-end=23:00 --cooloff=72 --skip-preflight 它会输出最终确定的决策 — 当前版本、时钟是否处于窗口内、符合条件的目标版本（如有），以及预检查阻碍项 — 最后以一个清晰的结论结束，例如 WOULD UPDATE → v1.33.2 或 WOULD NOT UPDATE (outside-window): …。 绝不会真正请求任何实际更新。

paragraphs.en: Once installed, Project NOMAD has a few helper scripts should you ever need to troubleshoot issues or perform maintenance that can't be done through the Command Center. All of these scripts are found in Project NOMAD's install directory, /opt/project-nomad
paragraphs.zh: 安装完成后，Project NOMAD 提供了一些辅助脚本，供您在需要排查问题或执行无法通过 Command Center（指挥中心）完成的维护工作时使用。 所有这些脚本都位于 Project NOMAD 的安装目录 /opt/project-nomad 中。

sents.en: Once installed, Project NOMAD has a few helper scripts should you ever need to troubleshoot issues or perform maintenance that can't be done through the Command Center.
sents.zh: 安装完成后，Project NOMAD 提供了一些辅助脚本，供您在需要排查问题或执行无法通过 Command Center（指挥中心）完成的维护工作时使用。

sents.en: All of these scripts are found in Project NOMAD's install directory, /opt/project-nomad
sents.zh: 所有这些脚本都位于 Project NOMAD 的安装目录 /opt/project-nomad 中。

paragraphs.en: sudo bash /opt/project-nomad/start_nomad.sh Stop Script - Stops all installed project containers sudo bash /opt/project-nomad/stop_nomad.sh Update Script - Attempts to pull the latest images for the Command Center and its dependencies (i.e. mysql) and recreate the containers. Note: this only updates the Command Center containers. It does not update the installable application containers - that should be done through the Command Center UI sudo bash /opt/project-nomad/update_nomad.sh Uninstall Script - Need to start fresh? Use the uninstall script to make your life easy. Note: this cannot be undone! curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crosstalk-Solutions/project-nomad/refs/heads/main/install/uninstall_nomad.sh -o uninstall_nomad.sh && sudo bash uninstall_nomad.sh About Project NOMAD is an offline-first knowledge and education server. Wikipedia, thousands of books, courses, maps, and optional local AI, all running on hardware you own with no internet required.
paragraphs.zh: sudo bash /opt/project-nomad/start_nomad.sh 停止脚本 - 停止所有已安装的项目容器 sudo bash /opt/project-nomad/stop_nomad.sh 更新脚本 - 尝试为指挥中心及其依赖项（例如 mysql）拉取最新镜像并重建容器。 注意：这只会更新指挥中心的容器。 它不会更新可安装的应用程序容器——那应该通过指挥中心的用户界面来完成。sudo bash /opt/project-nomad/update_nomad.sh 卸载脚本 - 需要重新开始？ 使用卸载脚本让您的生活更轻松。 注意：此操作无法撤销！curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Crosstalk-Solutions/project-nomad/refs/heads/main/install/uninstall_nomad.sh -o uninstall_nomad.sh && sudo bash uninstall_nomad.sh 关于 Project NOMAD 是一个离线优先的知识与教育服务器。 维基百科、数千本书籍、课程、地图，以及可选的本地智能体 AI，全部运行在您拥有的硬件上，无需互联网。
